declarations.reason: The datacenter floor, ceiling, column lattice, cable trays and light rows repeat without end and are re-tiled around the player each frame (src/world/components/EndlessDatacenter.tsx). The column lattice is also a game rule: packages/game/src/datacenter/layout.ts isStructuralColumnCell blocks movement, build placement, spawn and starter claims, so it stays with those rules instead of becoming a finite list of authored columns.

Claims, racks and placed build items are player data stored in Convex and streamed by chunk (api.world.worldScene, api.datacenter.listClaims); spawn points come from the cityHash seeds saved worlds were placed with. None of it is authored world content.
Other players and bots are live presence rows from Convex multiplayer; they never persist in the scene.
